jobs.occupation: Account Receivable & Credit Officer - Brussels - Food Sector

Jobomschrijving

We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to the Director General. This is a key position requiring exceptional organisational skills, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast-paced international environment.

Client Details

Description

• Coordinate international travel, itineraries, and meeting preparations
• Monitor and manage the Director General's inbox, correspondence, and follow-ups

• Ensure action points are tracked and deadlines are met across multiple projects

Join a prestigious international law firm as a Legal Assistant supporting a Partner, two Counsel, and several Associates within the Antitrust practice. This is a long-term opportunity for an experienced legal support professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys being a key contributor to a high-performing legal team.
 

Client Details

Our client is a globally renowned law firm with an outstanding reputation across the UK, the US, and international markets. With offices located worldwide, the firm advises leading multinational organizations on complex legal matters across various industries.

Due to continued growth of the Brussels office and an upcoming move to larger premises early next year, the firm is looking to strengthen its support team with an additional Legal Assistant. You will join a collaborative environment and work closely with another experienced Legal Assistant in a duo setup, ensuring seamless support to the legal team.

 

Description

This position is primarily focused on legal administration and billing support (approximately 90% of the role), with a smaller reception component (approximately 10%).
Legal & Administrative Support
• Manage complex billing processes and prepare client invoices with a high level of accuracy.
• Follow up on billing queries and liaise with lawyers and finance teams when needed.
• Prepare, format, proofread, and finalize legal documents, presentations, and correspondence.
• Manage agendas, schedule meetings, and coordinate appointments.
• Organize travel arrangements and business itineraries.
• Handle document management and maintain electronic filing systems.
• Open new client matters and support conflict check processes.
• Monitor deadlines and assist lawyers with day-to-day administrative requirements.
• Provide support to a Partner, two Counsel, and several Associates within the Antitrust practice.Reception Support (10%)
• Welcome visitors and clients in a professional and courteous manner.
• Answer and redirect incoming calls when required.
• Support the office with occasional front-desk coverage alongside the wider administrative team.
 

• Previous experience as a Legal Assistant, Practice Assistant, Legal Secretary, or similar support position within a law firm is essential.
• Proven experience managing legal billing and invoicing processes.
• Strong administrative and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
• Near-native level of English is mandatory.
• Good working knowledge of either French or Dutch (minimum B1 level).
• Comfortable supporting senior legal professionals in a demanding international environment.
• Proactive, resourceful, and capable of anticipating needs before they arise.
• Professional, discreet, and confident in managing confidential information.
• Team-oriented mindset with the ability to work closely in partnership with another Legal Assistant.
Candidates must already be based in Belgium and have the right to work in Belgium. Visa sponsorship cannot be provided for this position.

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• As a Production Worker, you will be responsible for making safety boots.

• Assembling components (steel toe cap, lining and steel sole) onto the mould

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.

Job Description

As a Dispatch and Labelling Line Supervisor  you will have a varied and responsible role.

Under the guidance of the Dispatch Team Leader, you will ensure that labelling and packaging activities are carried out correctly, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards.

You will coordinate and guide the employees working on the production line, ensuring that every product meets the applicable quality and food safety requirements, as well as customer specifications.

You will gradually grow into your role. You will start by being responsible for one production line. As you gain experience, the aim is for you to be able to operate and supervise all lines.

The Line Supervisor has an operational, monitoring, and coordinating role on the shop floor. You will ensure that the daily production schedule is completed within the allocated time while maintaining the required quality standards.

 

A selection of your responsibilities:

• Allocate tasks, provide clear work instructions, and guide employees working in filling and labelling. You will also help train new colleagues.

• Set up, operate, and change over packaging and labelling machines. Troubleshoot minor technical issues independently and report defects to the technical department in a timely manner.

• Check labels: use the ERP system to assign the correct production order to the right line and ensure that every product receives the correct label.

• Perform and record quality checks, including metal detection, residual oxygen measurements, visual packaging inspections, seal integrity checks, and final product weight checks.

• Ensure that each customer's packaging, labelling, and palletising instructions are followed correctly. Check stacking patterns, quantities, and pallet labels.

• Monitor compliance with HACCP, IFS Food, Food Defense, and hygiene requirements, and report any deviations to the Quality Department or your supervisor.

 

Who are you?

 

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English, including speaking, understanding, and reading. French is an advantage!

• You have experience working as an operator in another company, preferably in the food industry.

• You are familiar with packaging and labelling machines, including operating, setting up, and changing them over.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are stress-resistant and comfortable working at a fast pace on machinery. Things can get quite busy at Kjure-Marblo!

• You have strong administrative skills and are confident using computers.

• As working in the food industry involves strict quality, hygiene, and safety requirements, gel nails, excessive make-up, eyelash extensions, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted. We prefer a natural look. :-)

• You are comfortable working in a cold environment, with temperatures around 4°C.

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly?

As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:30 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Packaging Supervisor to join the  team on the night shift. 

Your responsibilities:

• A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.
• The ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple requests in a fast-paced environment.
ITIL, Microsoft, or other relevant certifications would be considered an advantage.On a personal level, you are recognised for your customer-centric mindset, team spirit, adaptability, and willingness to continuously learn and improve. You enjoy taking ownership, driving improvements, and delivering an outstanding support experience to end users.

• Leading international consulting organization supporting large-scale business and digital transformation programs across multiple industries.
